dogecoin.text: If only the #Crypto  community could make a decision to ignore @ElonMusk! Take a stand and say, ‘We don’t care what this guy thinks of #Bitcoin  & #Dogecoin . He might be the greatest living inventor, but this is our market, our industry, and he won’t define it’.
There was a time when books pumped 200%, not #altcoins. Hobbs' Leviathan mooned, basically. #Bitcoin $eth $doge #Crypto
